include(c_oracle.cmake)  # the pre-flip C as <target>_c: python -m rustconv.c_oracle

# setup16.exe is all Rust (setup16-rust) and cargo links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/setup16-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C stays on disk, uncompiled.
# The translated C, kept on disk:
# main.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/setup16-rust/src/setup16/main.rs)
add_cargo_module(setup16 setup16-cargo setup16.exe
    KIND win32exe
    BODY_CRATE setup16-rust
    DESTINATION reactos/system32)
